verdict.rationale: Mailgun is an email-sending/receiving API/service, not an agentic or orchestration product that consumes other tools' capabilities; the evidence shows Mailgun exposes itself AS an MCP server for AI assistants to control Mailgun (mailgun-docs-4, mailgun-docs-30, mailgun-docs-35, mailgun-probe-3), which is the opposite direction from 'plugging MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools'. This story asks about a client/orchestrator role that is outside Mailgun's product category.
